protocol: CN transfer validation: data verification and robustness checks for frozen CAP_DEF_M on the CN universe
rule: No parameter, rule or universe is selected or changed based on these checks. They are descriptive. The frozen CAP_DEF_M (momentum 12m, trend 40w) on the 6-ETF CN universe remains the only candidate.

sources.EM_HFQ: Eastmoney back-adjusted ETF bars: ak.fund_etf_hist_em(symbol, period='daily', adjust='hfq'), plus unadjusted (adjust='') for the suspension check
sources.EM_NAV: Eastmoney ETF NAV: ak.fund_etf_fund_info_em (unit NAV, accumulated NAV, daily NAV growth incl. distributions)
sources.EM_DIV: Eastmoney fund distribution/split records for the 6 ETFs (any akshare endpoint that returns them; record which)

checks.A1_price_adjustment: Daily return of our adj_close vs EM_HFQ close, per symbol, over 2013-07-29..2026-09-30 sessions present in both. Report: mean |diff|, max |diff| with date, count of days |diff| > 5 bp, annualized return of each series and their difference.
checks.A1_pass_if: for every symbol: |annualized return diff| <= 0.10 pp AND no day with |diff| > 50 bp that is not explained by a documented distribution/conversion date offset of at most 3 sessions
checks.A2_nav_tracking: Annualized total return of our adj_close vs NAV total return (from daily NAV growth) per symbol; report difference and correlation of daily returns.
checks.A2_pass_if: |annualized diff| <= 0.50 pp per symbol (premium/discount drift and fees make exact equality impossible)
checks.A3_corporate_actions: List every distribution (ex-date, amount per share) and conversion (date, ratio) from EM_DIV and compare with the Sina hfq.js records used in the baseline. Report matches and mismatches.
checks.A4_suspensions: Check whether EM unadjusted bars exist for 510500 on 2015-04-13/14 and 159915 on 2021-02-08.

part_A_data_verification.if_A_fails: Rerun the baseline transfer test unchanged except using EM_HFQ prices (adj_open/adj_close = hfq open/close), report it as 'data-corrected rerun' next to the baseline, and evaluate the original success criteria on both. If Eastmoney is unreachable, use any other independent source and say which.
part_A_data_verification.if_A_unreachable: Report which checks could not be done; do not substitute invented data.

part_B_robustness.common: Same engine, CN universe, groups, DEF, SHIBOR cash, amendment-1 suspension handling, primary cost 5+5 bps, benchmarks CSI300_BH and CN_60_40, partitions FULL/SUB_A/SUB_B, using the baseline (Sina self-adjusted) data. If Part A triggers a data-corrected rerun, run Part B on both datasets.

B1_parameter_neighbourhood.per_cell_check: FULL xSharpe > CN_60_40 FULL xSharpe AND FULL MDD < CSI300_BH FULL MDD

B2_execution_lag.definition: execute k sessions after the normal execution session (signal unchanged); k=0 is the baseline
B2_execution_lag.holds_if: all 5 offsets pass the per-cell check of B1

B3_etf_substitution.definition: run once with each substitution alone and once with both; same groups and universe order positions
B3_etf_substitution.data: fetched from the same source family as the baseline (Sina + self-built adjustment) using the baseline code path; if a substitute lacks history back to 2013-07-29, report NOT RUN for that variant
B3_etf_substitution.holds_if: every run that can be run passes the per-cell check of B1

B4_small_account_execution.rule: target shares rounded down to whole 100-share lots; leftover stays in cash (earns SHIBOR)
B4_small_account_execution.commission: max(5 CNY, 2.5 bp of trade value) per trade, plus 5 bp slippage per side; no stamp duty on ETFs
B4_small_account_execution.report: CAGR, xSharpe, MDD, mean cash weight vs the baseline (fractional, 5+5 bps)
B4_small_account_execution.holds_if: at 100000 CNY: CAGR drop vs baseline <= 1.0 pp and still passes the per-cell check of B1 (20000 CNY is reported only)

part_B_robustness.B5_2015_drawdown_decomposition: For the FULL-run max drawdown of CAP_DEF_M: peak date, trough date, recovery date; month-by-month holdings, weights, signal dates and each holding's contribution to the drawdown; and for each month whether the trend filter for each held asset was passing at the signal close.

outputs: research_v3/cn_transfer/validation/ : data_check.md + CSVs (Part A), robustness.md + CSVs (Part B), and a short VALIDATION_SUMMARY.md stating for each check PASS / FAIL / NOT RUN against the thresholds above.
freeze_rule: This protocol is frozen at commit time; any later change is a separately labelled amendment.
